_comment: #513 'Room on the Row'. Voice: character-profiles.md 'Gnoll Wool Trader' (T2, Plains Gnoll; ', yes?' at most once per node, 'Hrr.' once in the file). NEW graph on a NEW entity, so no shipped hub index moves. Start row needs no gold or stamp: the quest is startable on arrival with 0g, before the lift pass.

hub.speaker: Gnoll Wool Trader
hub.text: Plains wool, washed twice and baled tight. I came up through the Door with six bales and my grandmother's weights. The row has a counter free. They say my weights are Gnoll weights.

text_variants.text: You came back. That counter on the row is still empty. I can see it from here, yes?
Hrr. You have news on your face. Sit on a bale and tell me.
The den keeper sent one of her small ones up the row with a jar for me. Two more bales go down to her shelf tomorrow.
First bell tomorrow I set up at counter three. The brass goes in the cloth at night and on the counter in the morning.

options._comment: HELP route pointer. Hidden until the quest starts, gone once she has a place to sell.
options.text: Where else could you sell it?

options._comment: REPORT. Either route banks trader_placed; the payout is one-shot (hide_when on its own terminal).

started.speaker: Gnoll Wool Trader
started.text: Good. Start with the stallkeeper at the middle stall, the one with the lamps. She is the one who tells the story.

weights.speaker: Gnoll Wool Trader
weights.text: Brass, cast in Liscor, the same as theirs. Somebody here was cheated once by a trader with a hollow weight. She tells it to everyone who stops at her stall.

elsewhere.speaker: Gnoll Wool Trader
elsewhere.text: The den shop up by the stalls, the door with the painted sign. The keeper says she has a shelf if the wool gets there. Two bales fit it. I cannot carry them and stand here with the rest, yes?

payoff.speaker: Gnoll Wool Trader
payoff.text: Twelve gold. And take a bale with you. Somebody on this tier pays for good wool.

text_variants.text: The den keeper's small one brought up twelve gold from the shelf. It is yours. Take a bale too. Somebody on this tier pays for good wool.
Counter three, from first bell tomorrow. Here, twelve gold, out of what the row's regulars bought today. Take a bale too. Somebody on this tier pays for good wool.
